scripts.dev:up: node scripts/dev-pull.mjs && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up --build --pull missing -d && node scripts/wait-for-stack.mjs
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env logs -f api worker web
scripts.infra:up: node scripts/dev-pull.mjs --infra && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up -d --wait postgres redis rustfs mailpit
scripts.smoke:storage: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env exec -T api node dist/scripts/storage-smoke.js
scripts.dev:up:api: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up --build -d api && node scripts/wait-for-stack.mjs
scripts.dev:up:web: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up --build -d web && node scripts/wait-for-stack.mjs
scripts.dev:up:worker: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up --build -d worker && node scripts/wait-for-stack.mjs
scripts.verify: turbo run lint typecheck test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e; code=$?; pnpm dev:clean; exit $code
scripts.crawl: pnpm --filter @glasswork/e2e exec playwright test -c playwright.shots.config.ts crawl.shots
